map.tile_id_format: N|S + latitude x10 (3 digits), E|W + longitude x10 (4 digits), of the south-west corner
map.population_source_dataset: Scenario: 200 people in the tile containing the capital of each of the 38 OECD member countries; 0 elsewhere

order: index i -> row i//720, col i%720; south-west corner lat = 89.5 - 0.5*row, lon = 0.5*col - 180
